name: dockbook
description: Локальный генератор документации на чистых HTML/JS/CSS без БД и фреймворков

scripts.dev: test -d example && (cd example && node ../bin/dockbook.js dev) || node bin/dockbook.js dev
scripts.build: test -d example && (cd example && node ../bin/dockbook.js build) || node bin/dockbook.js build
scripts.preview: test -d example && (cd example && node ../bin/dockbook.js preview) || node bin/dockbook.js preview
